ex.en: This law will deprive us of our basic rights.
ex.zh: 這條法律會剝奪我們的基本權利。

ex.en: Needless to say, fundamental human rights should be respected.
ex.zh: 基本人權當然應該受到尊重。

ex.en: The house looked good; moreover, the price was right.
ex.zh: 這間房子看起來不錯，而且價格也合理。

ex.en: You're right. I made a mistake.
You have your right sock on wrong side out.
I've got my friend on the line right now.
ex.zh: 我朋友現在正在電話上。

ex.en: A sacred ritual took place in the magnificent temple.
ex.zh: 莊嚴的寺廟裡舉行了一場神聖的儀式。

ex.en: The Heavenly Timber Immolation is a kind of ancient ritual.
ex.zh: 燔柴祭天是一種古老的祭祀儀式。

ex.en: The sky cleared up after the ritual was over.
ex.zh: 祭祀結束後，天就放晴了。

ex.en: The river that flows through London is the Thames.
ex.zh: 流經倫敦的河是泰晤士河。

ex.en: This river is dangerous for children to swim in.
ex.zh: 這條河對小孩來說游泳很危險。

ex.en: The rivers were flooded by the heavy rain.
In order to do that, you have to take risks.
I don't want to run such a risk.
One who doesn't take risks will not win.
He risked losing all his fortune.
ex.zh: 他冒著失去所有財產的危險。
我知道你冒了多大的風險。
